title: Assistance Plan Output Types V1 (the closed vocabulary the create route accepts)
$comment: DL-KB-08. GET /api/assistance-plan-output-types answers with this document. The initial screen must offer an output type before any project exists, so the vocabulary cannot ride the project-scoped list route; it also cannot be hand-copied into TypeScript, because a second table would let the page offer a word the service refuses. Every value here is exactly what `assistance_plan.OUTPUT_TYPES` accepts, and the label is the Chinese name the screen shows for it. DL-KB-11 (2026-10-24) added `export_formats` to the same envelope under the same version: the material list is produced by `plan_export.material_table()` at the composition root, and this is the only surface the handoff screen reads before a plan exists, so it is where a page can learn which formats the service renders without typing the four words a second time. Each row is welded -- a format word, the content type and the filename extension a reader actually receives travel together, so a table that pairs markdown with .csv cannot be served through this contract.
